props.code:
# disposable parent
#   course/         (approved root)
#   course-other/   (outside sibling)

# WRONG:
str(target).startswith(str(root))

# RIGHT:
path = (base / target).resolve()
path.is_relative_to(base)

code_displays.intent: Code card in Claude cream skin: the two sibling directories, and the wrong string-prefix test contrasted with the resolved comparison.

props.title: chapters/05/symlink_fixture.py
props.code:
# inside a disposable /tmp/course
tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
root = Path(tmp) / "course"
root.mkdir()
elsewhere = Path(tmp) / "elsewhere.txt"
elsewhere.write_text("outside")
link = root / "link.txt"
link.symlink_to(elsewhere)

authorize(root, "link.txt", "read")
# -> PermissionError: Path escapes the data boundary

code_displays.intent: Code card in Claude cream skin: the symlink fixture as pseudo-shell + the resolve/containment call.

props.title: chapters/05/read_write_execute.py
props.code:
authorize(root, "notes.txt", "read")
# -> Path(...)/notes.txt

authorize(root, "notes.txt", "write")
# -> PermissionError: Write requires human approval

authorize(root, "notes.txt", "write", approved=True)
# -> Path(...)/notes.txt

authorize(root, "notes.txt", "execute", approved=True)
# -> PermissionError: Operation is not allowed

code_displays.intent: Code card in Claude cream skin: four calls against the same contained target with different operation and approval values, and the outcome each one produces.
